title: Peacock Place | KEY.co
description_expanded: This luxurious coastal retreat offers the perfect blend of comfort and elegance, designed to elevate your vacation experience. Nestled just moments from the Gulf, the home boasts stunning Gulf views and a private heated pool, making it an idyllic haven for relaxation. The spacious interior is easily accessible with an in-home elevator, leading to beautifully appointed bedrooms on each floor. The first floor features a Queen over Queen bunk room and a King bedroom, both offering comfort and style, while the second and third floors host additional King bedrooms, each with a private bathroom, ensuring a serene and restful stay. Beyond the interior, this vacation home comes equipped with everything needed for a memorable seaside escape. A six-seater golf cart and six adult bikes are included, perfect for exploring the picturesque surroundings. After a day of adventure, unwind by the pool or take in the breathtaking Gulf views from the comfort of your own private sanctuary. With every detail thoughtfully considered, this home promises an unparalleled experience of luxury and relaxation.
